correctness.rationale: Explicit eighteen-edge Frucht graph independently matches standard LCF representation. A full enumeration of 262,143 candidate nonempty masks yields exactly 1,025 valid matching faces. The deterministic 502-pair Morse matching leaves precisely one critical vertex and twenty critical dimension-three faces; all 3,629 Hasse cover relations are generated and a complete directed topological sort visits all 1,025 faces, proving acyclicity. Forman theory gives a CW complex with one 0-cell and twenty 3-cells, hence exactly a wedge of twenty 3-spheres integrally. Independent mod-two matrix ranks and Euler characteristic agree; no mod-two inference substitutes for the integral homotopy argument.

originality.rationale: Originality is an implication-based best-knowledge determination: the 2026 Möbius-ladder theorem classifies its perfect matching complexes, not the ordinary Frucht matching complex; the exact Frucht independence complex is a different simplicial construction; Franklin is a different graph with a different rank; graph-metric Vietoris–Rips results use vertices and not matchings. General claw-free connectivity theory supplies no exact rank-20 integral homotopy theorem. Targeted published-result and literature searches exposed no equivalent/dominating theorem, with unindexed overlap acknowledged.
residual_risks: A mathematically equivalent prior matching-complex computation may be unindexed or inaccessible; search nonappearance alone proves no uniqueness.
The broader full text of Engström was not needed to compare its abstract-level connectivity theorem, but could contain unrelated examples not seen.
The claim is a natural finite benchmark for the named graph, not a new all-cubic-graphs structure theorem.

value.rationale: The Frucht graph is the canonical smallest asymmetric cubic graph, providing a structurally motivated contrast to the 2026 highly symmetric Möbius-ladder topology and published Franklin-graph matching-complex classification. An exact integral matching-complex homotopy type is not implied by those sources or a face vector. The graph has maximal matching simplex dimension five but homotopy concentrated in degree three with a nontrivial twenty-sphere multiplicity. This is a natural complete finite classification suitable as a benchmark for asymmetric cubic graph complexes, without an unsupported generalization.
